title: Fix GLTF texture sampler T wrapping
body:
## Summary
- Fix `GLTFTextureSampler::set_wrap_t()` to assign `wrap_t` without mutating S.
- Add regression coverage for `S=CLAMP_TO_EDGE, T=REPEAT` and the reverse combination.

## Validation
- `git diff --check` passed.
- Native Godot build/tests were not run: Python/SCons and a C++ compiler are unavailable, and no prebuilt Godot binary is present.

## Limitation
- The importer still maps sampler wrapping to `BaseMaterial3D::FLAG_USE_TEXTURE_REPEAT`, a single boolean. It cannot represent distinct U/V wrap modes; this fix does not add asymmetric-wrap rendering support.
